verdict.rationale: A test or sandbox environment is a fair question for an online legal-services SaaS platform, since such services could offer test modes for programmatic filings. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, or staging environment separate from production. The llms.txt probe only provides crawler guidance and is unrelated to sandboxed testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
